# Original Candidate Description

**Source:** `.github/agents/student.agent.md` (baseline before optimization)

**Known weaknesses identified in engineer-prompt/review.md:**
1. Approval prediction under-specified — no concrete criteria
2. Teacher handoff trigger vague ("unclear" is ambiguous)
3. Engineer handoff threshold unclear
4. Revision scope not anchored to artifact priority order
5. Reasoning format guidance aspirational but not operational (lists options, no decision rule)
6. Validation step lacks definition of done
7. Loop exit criterion one-sided (no explicit over-revision check)
